english.title: Stormwind Library
english.progress: King Anduin has placed great importance on learning, and thus has provided funds for making copies of various tomes and writings available to the public. It's very simple. You bring me a library scrip, and I can give you a copy of one of the available books.
english.complete: Do any of these titles interest you, <name>?

english.title: Onu is Meditating
english.complete:
I am meditating on your task, <name>.  Meditating on reasons why the Twilight's Hammer and naga are here.

When you are ready, use the phial of scrying to create a scrying bowl.  Then, contact me through the bowl.

If you have lost your phial of scrying, then here is another.

english.title: Grant's Shield
english.objective: Find Grant's Mace on one of the skeletons in Raven Hill Cemetery then return to Sirra Von'Indie in Darkshire for more information.
english.detail:
A shield left behind by the specter of Grant Valor, father of the Valor family and hero of Raven Hill.

With Grant's spirit still battling the undead, perhaps his unfinished business was to slay the scourge that injured him in the Raven Hill Cemetery. It is likely the one his mace is still imbedded in.

english.title: Grant's Shield
english.objective: Find Grant's Mace on one of the skeletons in Raven Hill Cemetery then return to Sirra Von'Indie in Darkshire for more information.
english.complete:
For a man as proud as Grant Valor to be brought low by such a simple creature says less about him and more about the horrors of battle. It only takes one slip to be crippled for life.

These weapons tell a great deal about their owner. Let me take some time to study them.

english.title: Silvia's Sword
english.objective: Defeat 7 Defias Night Blades and 7 Defias Enchanters in Addle's Stead then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
english.detail:
A sword left by the spirit of Raven Hill's guard, Silvia Valor, who lived her life protecting civilians and their homes.

With Silvia's spirit still visiting farmsteads, perhaps her unfinished business was to route the defias who have taken up residence in Addle's Stead south of Raven Hill.

english.title: Silvia's Sword
english.objective: Defeat 7 Defias Night Blades and 7 Defias Enchanters in Addle's Stead then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
english.progress: You look like you've seen a ghost!
english.complete:
Silvia Valor, hmm? Ah, yes. A fine warrior and a defender of our way of life--albeit with a narrow vision of what that was.

Your guess is as good as mine what she would want, but the defias was a good start. Let me study this blade further.

english.title: Ira's Dagger
english.objective: Defeat 10 Young Black Ravagers and 7 Black Ravagers then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
english.detail:
A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.

With Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.

english.title: Ira's Dagger
english.objective: Defeat 10 Young Black Ravagers and 7 Black Ravagers then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
english.complete:
Ira? Are you sure? Sounds like the woman was damn near a ghost before she died. I'm surprised you found her.

Rest assured I will take great care of this dagger.

english.title: Merrick's Bow
english.objective: Defeat 8 Splinter Fist Warriors and 4 Splinter Fist Taskmasters then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
english.detail:
A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.

english.title: Merrick's Bow
english.objective: Defeat 8 Splinter Fist Warriors and 4 Splinter Fist Taskmasters then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
english.complete:
Merrick Valor, you say? Poor boy always wanted to prove himself. It was a shame what happened to him and his family.

Thank you for bringing this, <name>. Perhaps it can shed some additional light on Raven Hill's history.

english.title: The Manor, Ravenholdt
english.objective:
Take the Seal of Ravenholdt to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad.

Your cunning will be tested along the way. Be prepared.
english.detail:
<Name>,

Ravenholdt has taken an interest in you, young thief. We have been watching. Your style is a bit awkward but nothing we couldn't fix.

Should you be prepared to embark on a career as a disciple of Master Ravenholdt and member of the Assassin's League, you have only to bring the Seal of Ravenholdt (attached to this letter) to Ravenholdt Manor.

Your first task is to find the manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad and demonstrate your cunning.

Regards,

Fahrad
english.complete:
Most excellent, young thief.

You look a bit beaten down, but no worse for the wear.

A long journey awaits you - long and rewarding. Are you prepared to finally embrace your destiny among the masters of Ravenholdt?

Speak with the guards outside. They will get you started.

english.title: Syndicate Sabotage
english.objective: Find Lord Tomas inside Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills, and kill him. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform.
english.detail:
Sometimes, <Race>, a single cut in the right place will drop a foe dead. The same is often true of organizations.

Our agents have identified a key target among the ranks of the Syndicate: a man by the name of Lord Tomas.

He plays an instrumental role in the functions of Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you wish to be of service to Ravenholdt, go to Durnholde and eliminate him. The quicker, and quieter, the better.

english.title: Syndicate Sabotage
english.objective: Find Lord Tomas inside Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills, and kill him. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform.
english.complete:
With Tomas dead, Durnholde Keep will no doubt be destabilized. Lowly thugs of the Syndicate's kind often fall to disarray without a figurehead to lead them.

Good work, <name>. I may call upon you for future missions.

english.title: The Horn of Xelthos
english.objective: Find The Horn of Xelthos inside of Shadowfang Keep. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.
english.detail:
<A note sits in the chest>

Hello, <Name>.

I desire a treasure known as The Horn of Xelthos, which is somewhere within Shadowfang Keep.

Venturing inside the keep usually calls for backup. However, for this job, a low profile is of utmost importance.

You must go alone.

I have a contact, by the name of Veenix, in the Stonetalon Mountains. He should be able to help you get past the courtyard gate. The rest is up to you. 

Return the horn here, and your payment will be sent soon after.

- C
